title: Business Membership Tenure Relief on Returns
content:
**Membership age.** Under the Business return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the age of the Northgate+ Business membership on the return date adds to the relief fraction of the reversal. Age is counted in whole calendar months from the membership's term start date to the return date, a month counting when the return date reaches the same day of the month as the term start date.

| Whole calendar months from the term start date to the return date | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 0.1 |
| 12 to fewer than 24 | 0.05 |
| fewer than 12, or no term start date recorded | nothing |

**Boundary pair (hypothetical term start date 27 January 2030).** A return dated 26 January 2032 is 23 whole months on and adds 0.05; one dated 27 January 2032 is 24 whole months on and adds 0.1.
